topic: AI agent harnesses for multi-step research workflows
instructions: Using the provided sources, produce a one-page brief that summarizes the competitive landscape, the strongest evidence for each major claim, and two unresolved questions that require further investigation.

sources.title: Source 1
sources.content: ThruWire-style graph execution systems make dependencies explicit, preserve intermediate state, and support selective recomputation after upstream changes.

sources.title: Source 2
sources.content: Traditional chat harnesses preserve work through transcript memory and iterative prompting, which is flexible but makes structured reuse and replay difficult.

sources.title: Source 3
sources.content: Recent agent research emphasizes planning, memory, and reflection, but many systems still reconstruct intermediate state through prompts rather than explicit execution graphs.

source.title: Source 2 (revised)
source.content: A revised source argues that memory-rich chat interfaces can preserve local continuity effectively for short workflows, but their update behavior degrades as dependencies become more interlinked.
